title: Live H1 Generic Controls
objective: Remove answer-derived workspace capacity and preselected retry precision from the authentic h1 experimental root controls, replacing them with live-shape capacity bounds and the pinned PARI 2.17.4 retry transition.

oracles: Pinned PARI 2.17.4 buch2.c capacity and precision-transition policy

handoff.summary: The resident cubic root now sizes factor-base owners from degree times the live prime count rather than an observed fixture KC. A source-transparent retry controller computes one next attempt from a live PRECI or cleanarch failure using pinned PARI 2.17.4 policy; it contains no known-success precision. CPython, generated JavaScript, GMP, and tagged focused checks agree.
risks: The full precision-dependent logarithm/getfu suffix is not yet connected as an iterative root, so this component deliberately makes no terminal-precision or end-to-end completion claim.
Historical HNF and acceptance scratch caps outside the factor-base K owners remain experimental resource bounds documented by the resident-root audit.
next_steps: Have the integration root allocate using pari_live_root_capacity_policy and call pari_live_retry_transition only after each executed attempt reports its live reason.
Connect precision-dependent embedding, logarithm, cleanarch, and getfu owners so runtime success, rather than 2176/2240 fixture knowledge, terminates the retry loop.
